body:
### Problem
A missed-review notice only shows on a page that was already open when the notice was logged. When a page connects to the event stream, it gets a snapshot of the current state (`board::server`) and then only new events. That snapshot has no `missedReviews`, and neither the System Review page nor the Delivery page fetches `GET /system-reviews/missed`. The most common case fails: the app was closed when a review was due, the notice is logged at startup before any page connects, and nobody sees it. The comment in `review_schedules` that says "a page that connects later is given it" is wrong. The in-memory list only stops the same notice from being announced twice.

### Done when
- A System Review or Delivery page opened after a notice was logged shows that notice, as the feature describes (System Review always; Delivery until the notice is read).
- A test covers a notice logged before any page connects.
- The `review_schedules` comment says what the code does.

How a page gets the notices (in the snapshot, or by fetching `/system-reviews/missed`) is up to the worker.
title: sysreview: missed notice on pages opened later
